scope: Backend caching: 10 new candidates for round6; 6 retained and 4 rejected, within cache/sidebar/extras reservations. No auth/router/Drive/file/alias/transform source edits.

passes.candidate: Reuse complete immutable bulk-cache, cold/warm sidebar tree, refreshed-at, and sidebar-overlay read statements with fresh execution bindings.
passes.method: Memoize the remaining complete read shapes, parameterize current namespace/key arrays and current user/drive/exact tuple-version values, and cache the overlay UNION shape. Compare saved baseline service modules with final modules using the same protector, data, and PostgreSQL engine; separately measure shape construction with injected sessions.

workload.cache: 4096 encrypted rows with keys round6:{fixture_owner}:{i} and values {value:key}; read 1,32,4096 keys, 21 alternating pairs each, one operation/sample.
workload.overlay: Two current users, one with hidden workspace hidden, folder-1 icon and drive-1 order, one with defaults; 31 pairs each.
workload.sidebar: Already-decoded warm trees with 1 or 1000 document files f-{i}, names File {i}; each call still performs a fresh PostgreSQL exact-version query, 31 pairs each.
workload.shapeOnly: Injected no-I/O session and deterministic query protector, q{i} keys at 1,32,128,4096; 31 pairs of three calls.

evidence.semanticEvidence: Public-service tests verify shared statement identity with different namespaces, principal IDs, drive IDs and keys; real PostgreSQL tests observe expiration, cross-user isolation and same-refreshed-at row replacement. No cache result or fresh PostgreSQL expression is memoized.

limits: This is one read-shape reuse candidate across related read paths, not one candidate per statement. Prior storage-r5-02 single-cache SELECT reuse, prior UNION batching and prior JOIN UNNEST/tuple-version selection are not recounted.
4096-key real read median 43.750458 to 43.605458 ms is effectively flat; retain for repeatable small/warm construction savings, not a large-read throughput claim.
Statement caches have finite boolean read variants; sidebar expression-shape reuse is bounded to four entries. Every call binds fresh values and evaluates current expiry/snapshot metadata.
Tree benchmark is warm and includes the final metadata index; construction-only cache probes isolate shape reuse more directly. No authorization path was modified.

evidence.semanticEvidence: Key/envelope arrays stay paired in the existing physical lock order, current namespaces/TTL values bind per call, cleanup appears only in the first chunk, and a later-chunk failure rolls back the entire batch. limits: Prior array UNNEST insertion, tiny-write threshold, batching, cleanup predicate/index and ordered physical row locks remain unchanged and count zero. New work is complete write-shape reuse with fresh bound inputs.

evidence.semanticEvidence: Public stale-cache paths schedule real background tasks using injected provider failures/blockers. evidence.decision: Extra inner tasks fall 1 to 0; isolated scheduler median 0.22874585 to 0.00419795 ms in the final guarded whole-harness run. Deterministic task count is the primary resource result.

limits: No provider, database or crypto latency is modeled in the scheduling microbenchmark; absolute scheduler medians vary with host load. No production latency claim.
An initial direct-await except Exception variant failed broad-exception lint and was replaced before retention; repairs and all repeated gate runs count zero.
